CREATE FUNCTION series_source(n int) RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT g FROM pg_catalog.generate_series(1, n) AS g$$
SELECT * FROM series_source(n => 3) AS t(value) ORDER BY value
CREATE FUNCTION series_standard(n int) RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT g FROM pg_catalog.generate_series(1, n) AS g; END
SELECT * FROM series_standard(n => 3) AS t(value) ORDER BY value
